summary: emit runs the typecheck the last lock records before running the program; a first emit, with no lock, runs it right after
acceptance: with a lock recording a failing typecheck, emit refuses with the typecheck's diagnostics even when the program itself would fail to run
tests: emit runs the typecheck the last lock records before running the program
emit records the program's typecheck in the lock
pins: a first emit with no lock runs the declared typecheck after the program
notes: Spec 9f21c8fe (0108). Today emit_program (src/drift.rs ~1943) runs the program twice, then the payload's typecheck; the lock drops the row (drift.rs ~6745 'seam-inbound only').
